faq.q: Where are the parks and recreation facilities in this part of Ladner?
faq.a: Memorial Park (5010 47 Ave) and Cromie Park (4907 42b Ave) are City of Delta parks in central Ladner, and Ladner Leisure Centre is at 4600 Clarence Taylor Crescent.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Ladner?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Ladner?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.
